name: resumestart
description: Create professional resumes from ChatGPT and edit them in your ResumeStart account.

interface.longDescription: Create a professional resume from details you share in chat, then pick its template from an inline carousel. The resume is saved to your own ResumeStart account and shown as an inline preview with a link to open and edit it on ResumeStart. Requires a ResumeStart account.

positive.description: Create a resume from full details
positive.prompt: Use the ResumeStart plugin to create a resume for Jordan Lee, Senior Frontend Engineer at Northwind (2020-present, built a design system used by 12 teams), BS Computer Science from State University, skills: TypeScript, React, Node.js.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the resume to the user's ResumeStart account, shows an inline resume preview, and returns an Edit in ResumeStart link.

positive.description: Create a resume for a career changer
positive.prompt: Using the ResumeStart plugin, make me a resume. I'm Priya Shah, a high school math teacher for 8 years (Lincoln High, 2016-present) moving into data analysis. I built grade dashboards in Excel used by 40 teachers. Master of Education from Riverside University. Skills: Excel, SQL, Python, data visualization.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the resume to the user's ResumeStart account, shows an inline resume preview, and returns an Edit in ResumeStart link.

positive.description: Create an entry-level resume with education only
positive.prompt: Use ResumeStart to create my resume. I'm Marcus Chen, a recent graduate with a BS in Computer Science from Eastside University (2021-2025, GPA 3.7). I interned at Brightpath as a software engineering intern in summer 2024 and built an internal tool for QA. Skills: Java, Python, Git.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the resume to the user's ResumeStart account, shows an inline resume preview, and returns an Edit in ResumeStart link.

positive.description: Show template options for a resume
positive.prompt: Use the ResumeStart plugin to create a resume for Jordan Lee, Senior Frontend Engineer at Northwind (2020-present, built a design system used by 12 teams), BS Computer Science from State University, skills: TypeScript, React, Node.js. Then show me the template options so I can pick a design.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the resume, then shows an inline carousel of resume templates with preview images. Selecting one applies it to the saved resume.

positive.description: Apply a named template to a saved resume
positive.prompt: Using the ResumeStart plugin, create a resume for Sofia Alvarez, Product Manager at Contoso (2021-present, launched a mobile app with 200k downloads), MBA from Lakeside University, skills: roadmapping, user research, SQL. Use the Meridian template.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the resume, applies the Meridian template to it, and returns an Edit in ResumeStart link.

negative.prompt: Use the ResumeStart plugin to buy me a premium plan and charge my card.
Use the ResumeStart plugin to delete my ResumeStart account and all my resumes.
Use the ResumeStart plugin to submit my resume to 20 jobs on LinkedIn for me.

review.commerce_description: ResumeStart does not sell products or process payments within ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing account.

publication.release_notes: New: after creating a resume in ChatGPT, browse resume templates in an inline carousel and apply one with a click.
